name: Decile rating

lead: The decile rating is a way of rating attractiveness on a 1-to-10 scale, with each step representing a decile (a tenth) of the population. A 5 is roughly average and a 10 is among the top tenth. It is used to compare people to a population baseline instead of to models.
In looksmaxxing it helps people set targets for how far appearance changes might take them, and it is often discussed alongside PSL ratings.

paras: Members post photos for rating threads and explain how scores map to percentiles; one guide describes PSL and percentile ratings together, and others apply decile scores to celebrities.
Ratings from online strangers are subjective. Critics of rating culture, cited in media coverage of looksmaxxing, link it to body-image concerns.

angle.text: The decile scale gives users a shared number for where they stand, which they use to choose and track improvements.

lead: The decile rating or decile scale is a 1-to-10 system for rating physical attractiveness, where each number corresponds to a decile of the population.[1]

In looksmaxxing communities it is used alongside the PSL scale, which rates male facial attractiveness on a 1-to-8 hierarchy designed to reflect how women perceive men.[2] A looksmax.org rating guide describes PSL as originally comparing people to male models, with an average of 4, and gives percentile equivalents.[1]
The scale gives users a reference point for rating threads and goals: someone placing themselves at a certain decile can discuss which changes might raise it.

paras: The decile scale divides the population into ten groups. Forum users explain how decile scores relate to PSL and to percentiles, with the PSL middle being 4 and each point up or down a step.[1] Wikipedia describes PSL as having tiers from sub-3 through normie, Chadlite and Chad to giga Chad.[2]
Members apply the scale to celebrities and to forum members in rating threads, including threads grading celebrities by decile.[3]
No studies found of the decile scale as used in looksmaxxing. Academic uses of the word "decile" in other fields, such as school socioeconomic ranking, are unrelated.

lore.intro: The decile scale appears in rating threads and explainer posts on looksmax.org.[1][3]
